steps.name: Archosauria Punk A
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Archosauria Punk B
steps.text: S-She's strong...

steps.name: Uda
steps.text: You're not half bad, I'll give you that!

steps.name: Aruna
steps.text: Don't get cocky, Eunectes!

steps.name: Aruna
steps.text: All of you, on me!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mm, I knew it! Zumama's so tough!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: She may be fighting alone, but just like Gavial, your everyday Archosauria goonies are no match for her.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But...

options: It sounds like you know her pretty well.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep, Zumama and Gavial have always been the strongest around here.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But as far as I know, Zumama has never managed to beat Gavial!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Doctor. I bet you don't see people this strong on the outside!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But Gavial's even stronger than her!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yeah, I agree. Zumama is cool.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But Gavial's way cooler!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Right, Gavial?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Huh? Where's Gavial?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hey, look! Over there!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: I saw her on my way here! Isn't that—

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: She really is back!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Gavial!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wahhhh!! Gavial rushed onto the platform!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's been a while, Zumama!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Or should I call you the leader of the Eunectes now?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You came back, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That's right, Tomimi asked me to come back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Hold up. You know Sargonian?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...Since you're speaking Sargonian too, I guess this really is what they speak on the outside.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I've been studying it for a long time.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...I thought you weren't ever going to come back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, I'll come back. Not right now, but someday. This is my home, after all.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you trying to become the Great Chief?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Nope, I need you for something else, and I was gonna wait till you were done.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I didn't expect to see you get this badass, though. How am I supposed to hold myself back from fighting you?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you really a doctor now?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Sure am.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hehe, I'm a pretty famous doctor out there!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That's amazing.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What about you? You didn't show up last time because you were tinkering with something, right? You done with that yet?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...Yeah.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You'll get to see it very soon.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ugh... didn't Gavial say she wasn't going to fight her...?

options: That's the Gavial we know and love.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Hm? N-Not at all! I-It's just...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Even the Doctor's taken with her...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ughh... I mean, she does look super cool, but...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh... it's true.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're as strong as I remember.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Heh, you ain't half bad either!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But you rely on your fists too much.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You can do all sorts of things with your fists, so you don't ever think of using anything else.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: That's what's holding you back, and it's what's holding all of us back.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What are you talking about?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What I'm trying to say is it's time for change.
Just then, a thunderous, uniform roar reverberates through the forest. Something gigantic is approaching the Temple.
Whatever it is, it is slowly but surely stomping its way towards the Temple, and although it has so far remained largely out of sight, it has already proven to be an imposing presence.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're strong, Gavial. There's no doubt about that.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I wasn't going to use this until after I took the throne.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But I have to use it against you now.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It doesn't matter. The end result will still be the same.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: This is going to bring us change.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I've got no idea what you're talking about, but I'm not going down that easy!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes you are.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: ...High Priest. Aim. Fire!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What's... that?!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: See? I told you, Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But using it against you isn't what I'm trying to accomplish here.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: We won't have a future if we always rely on our fists.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: From here on out, we're in the age of machines.
